comments: Overall the study was clear and straightforward. A few suggestions: define attribute levels more precisely (e.g., what counts as “high” spending or “ambitious” climate action), offer a “no preference” option or allow ties, and provide a brief practice pair so participants understand trade-offs. Also include an estimated completion time/progress bar and a short debrief explaining how responses will be used and privacy protections.

Overall the survey was straightforward and easy to complete. The policy pairs captured high-level trade-offs well, but I would suggest clearer definitions of the spending categories (for example, what exactly is included in ‘healthcare spending’), more realistic cost or outcome estimates, and an option to explain trade-offs or rank attributes for each choice. Adding follow-up questions to capture respondents’ reasons for each selection would also be helpful. Thank you.

The survey was clear and easy to follow. I appreciated the consistent attribute format, but it would help to include more specific details (e.g., exact spending amounts or expected outcomes) and information about trade-offs or fiscal impacts. Adding a brief description of how each attribute level translates into real-world effects would make choices feel more informed. Overall length and time were reasonable.

Thank you for the opportunity to participate. The survey was clear and easy to complete. A few suggestions: provide more context about trade-offs and funding sources for the proposals, use more precise/realistic policy descriptions, and consider adding a "no preference" option for some pairs. I’d appreciate a summary of the study results and confirmation that responses will remain anonymous.

I appreciate a summary of the study results when available.
